question.prompt: The PRD names the airbnb.co.in homepage but does not provide a runnable exact start URL for these web tests.

options.label: Use {{homepage_url}}
options.detail: Keep the tests authored with a required {{homepage_url}} runtime variable until a full URL is supplied.

options.label: Provide exact URL
options.detail: Supply the full homepage URL the tests must open.

content.risk_rationale: Without an exact start URL, both web tests remain configuration-dependent and cannot run as-authored in a new environment.
